Hadith.983 - It is narrated from Misma‘ Kardin that He said:
"I prayed with Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) for forty mornings. Whenever he finished the prayer, he would raise his hands toward the sky and say:
Asbahna wa asbaha al-mulku lillah. Allahumma inna ‘ibaduka wa abna’u ‘ibadika. Allahumma ihfazna min haythu nahtaﬁz wa min haythu la nahtaﬁz. Allahumma uhrosna min haythu nahtarisu wa min haythu la nahtarisu. Allahumma usturna min haythu nastatiru wa min haythu la nastatiru. Allahumma usturna bil-ghina wa al-‘aﬁyah. Allahumma urzuqna al-‘aﬁyah wa dawama al-‘aﬁyah, wa urzuqna ash-shukra ‘ala al-‘aﬁyah
'We have entered the morning and the dominion belongs to Allah (swt). O’ Allah (swt), we are Your servants, the children of Your servants. O’ Allah (swt), protect us from every angle we strive to protect ourselves from and from angles we do not perceive. O’ Allah (swt), guard us from every direction we seek to guard ourselves and from those we do not foresee. O’ Allah (swt), conceal us with sufficiency and wellbeing. O’ Allah (swt), grant us wellbeing and the continuity of wellbeing and grant us the thankfulness for this wellbeing.'"
